question: Can frozen tied-token weights turn unseen temporal cue pairs into a direction-invariant semantic router that separates A1, A2, and off on sealed v16?

prior_art.known_lessons: Exact token lookup has zero v16 support; signed source deltas reverse with tense direction; high-dimensional ridge memorizes a direction; coarse response Gram features leak P. The new feature must be frozen, direction invariant, and outcome-free.
prior_art.novelty: Use pretrained tied embedding geometry of the changed lexical pairs, rather than task-fitted hidden states: concatenate the normalized mean unordered-pair midpoint with the normalized mean elementwise-squared pair difference, then use three cosine centroids.

frozen_design.population: Use aligned A1/A2/P/C v15 rows for opposite-parity fitting and held-parity replay. On v16, score all aligned A1/A2/P rows; explicitly exclude the known variable-length C rows rather than padding them.
frozen_design.feature: For each unequal aligned token pair through the semantic position, RMS-normalize both tied input embeddings, compute midpoint e_i+e_j and squared difference (e_i-e_j)^2, average each over changed positions, L2-normalize each block, and concatenate. Sorting/direction is irrelevant by construction. Empty signatures map to zero.
frozen_design.router: For each fold, compute unit cosine centroids for A1, A2, and pooled P/C off on opposite-parity v15 only. Predict v15 held and sealed v16 by maximum cosine with frozen class order A1,A2,off. No regularization, thresholds, label-specific gains, or v16 selection.
frozen_design.controls: Bind checkpoint/builders/results/helper hashes, exact row inventories, direction invariance, finite features, v15 train-held disjointness, v16 nonoverlap, fold agreement, and literal zero-transformer price.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_direction_inv: All hashes/configuration, row inventories, aligned populations, explicit v16 C exclusion, direction invariance, finite features, disjoint splits, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_v15_crossfit_router_is_selective: Both v15 held folds have macro accuracy 1.0 and zero P/C rows predicted target.
predictions.pred_c_v16_semantic_router_generalizes: Each frozen fold has v16 A1/A2/P macro accuracy >=0.75 and zero P rows predicted target.
predictions.pred_d_both_v16_target_constructions_are: Each fold correctly routes at least 12/16 A1 and 12/16 A2 rows.
predictions.pred_e_frozen_folds_agree_on_v16: The two opposite-parity fits make identical predictions on every scored v16 row.

decision: A/B/C/D/E licenses one hash-bound v16 causal execution of the existing rank-two program. B failure rejects this embedding representation in-distribution. B pass with C/D/E failure is an honest semantic-router OOD null and forbids threshold or ridge tuning on v16.
